text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 — billing metering anomaly detected for token-collector service. High variance between real-time emitter and ledger. Alerting onage-flag spikes.
Aisha: seeing ~15% token undercount on ingestion shard eu-2 starting 10:42 UTC. dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/collector-eu2
Rob: confirmed. Replaying 10:30-10:50 kafka partition 12 shows retries + duplicate acks.
Kai: rolling a quick consumer restart on eu-2 to clear stuck offsets. Doing canary on consumer-12 only.
Marta: tagging customers with sudden overage flags — product-support, please prepare comms hold.
BillingBot: computed drift: emitter -> ledger delta = -147k tokens over last 20m, estimated revenue delta ~$42. Customer impact possible for high-volume customers.
oncall-sre: I'm on it, @Aisha take the restart, I'll watch replay metrics and token tallies.
Aisha: restart command: `kubectl -n billing rollout restart deploy/token-collector-eu2 --field-manager=ops`
Rob: logs show `ProcessorCheckpoint: commit timeout` repeated, then `offsets stalled` before gap. Pasting sample:
```
2026-03-17T10:41:12Z token-collector consumer-12 WARN ProcessorCheckpoint: commit timeout 5000ms
2026-03-17T10:41:25Z token-collector consumer-12 ERROR offsets stalled for 2 partitions
```
Kai: consumer restart completed on consumer-12. Observability: inflight-lag dropped from 3500 -> 1200.
Marta: SupportLead, can you draft a one-line internal blurb we can escalate to AMs if ledger correction will take >1h?
SupportLead: Draft: "We're investigating a temporary metering discrepancy affecting a subset of EU customers; we're actively replaying events and expect a resolution within 2 hours. We'll update if any billing adjustments are required."
BillingBot: triggered mitigation workflow: switch to fallback emitter (stateless prefix-caching) in 2m, and enable high-fidelity sampling for suspected customers.
Rob: starting replay: `kafka-consumer-replay --topic=token-events --partition=12 --from-offset=67012345 --to-offset=67024600 --dry-run=false`
Aisha: replay started, reprocessing at 1.2x to catch up. Observed temporary spike in duplication. Applying dedupe filter on ingest: `ingest.filter.dedupe=true`
Marta: product-support: hold on sending any external emails until we know whether customers will see underbilling or if we need to post-credit.
Kai: patching consumer to increase commit timeout to 30s and enable heartbeat backoff. Will push patched image to canary.
oncall-sre: rolling patched consumer image to two more replicas. Monitoring ledger-emit delta.
BillingBot: ledger reconciliation job queued. ETA for first reconciliation pass: ~45 minutes.
Rob: reconciliation run shows bulk of missing tokens were re-emitted but ~22k tokens still unaccounted for from 10:38-10:44 window. Investigating whether emitter filtered them by checksum mismatch.
Aisha: quick check with emitter logs: several `checksum_mismatch` entries correlate with a transient storage error on node storage-eu2-07.
Marta: considering escalation to infra-storage if nodee shows IO errors. @Kai can you confirm node health?
Kai: storage-eu2-07 has elevated iops and a soft node reboot earlier at 10:35 UTC — kernel OOM killer logged some cleanup of local cache. Filing infra ticket: #INFRA-4987.
SupportLead: customers currently flagged as potential overages: cust-142, cust-78, cust-990. I'll prepare targeted messages once we know final token tallies.
BillingBot: temp action: disabled automated overage email triggers to avoid noise. Flagged customers will not receive automated alerts until manual review.
Rob: once replay finishes we'll run `ledger.diff --window=10:30-10:50 --granularity=1m` and produce CSV for finance.
Aisha: replay complete at 11:30 UTC. Running reconciliation now.
BillingBot: reconciliation summary: re-emitted tokens recovered 124,900 tokens. Remaining gap: -22,100 tokens. Candidate cause: checksum drop on storage-eu2-07 leading to emitter suppression.
Kai: infra confirms storage-eu2-07 disk reported transient corruption on a write buffer; repaired and remounted at 10:50 UTC. We're pulling fsck logs.
Marta: product-support: recommendations? If gap remains <50k tokens, prefer issuing a customer credit for affected window rather than retroactively rebilling. Need approval from finance.
SupportLead: tentative external comms if credit approved: "We detected a metering discrepancy impacting a small subset of EU customers between 10:35–10:50 UTC. We've corrected counts and will apply a small credit if you were affected. No action required from customers."
oncall-sre: next steps: 1) finish ledger full-pass (ETA 20m) 2) confirm final numbers 3) if gap persists, create billing-adjustment run & finance ticket 4) post internal bridge recap.
Rob: ledger full-pass completed at 11:45 UTC. Final gap: -21,981 tokens (~$6.6). Finance okayed credit path for undercount (no retro bill).
Marta: approving customer comms. @SupportLead send external email at 12:05 UTC with the one-liner.
SupportLead: external message sent to affected customers. Link to post-incident internal doc: https://wiki.internal/incidents/1769129999-metering-drift
incident-bot: Incident update: SEV-2 -> resolved (metering drift mitigated, consumers patched, storage node repaired, credits applied). Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
